{"parentUuid":"ce2f3963-bbc2-4866-8374-28f9aa9b9489","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"mcp_instructions_delta","addedNames":["plugin:context7:context7","plugin:serena:serena"],"addedBlocks":["## plugin:context7:context7\nUse this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service -- even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. {"parentUuid":"21f6f0ec-b3f6-4546-a4ef-01b82954ea18","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- empirical-probe-first: Probe ALL viable strategies in a multi-option ladder BEFORE committing to one. Use when a session-plan / decision-ADR / spec presents ≥3 strategy options (e.g. \"Strategy A1/A2/A3\" or \"alternative B/C/D\") and the recommended option's source-evidence may be stale. Outputs a probe matrix per strategy + commit decision with empirical citation. Pairs with `vendor-api-probe.sh` (deterministic detection layer; SessionStart hook) and `decompose-work` (deterministic-vs-LLM split per probe). Charter promotion target — codifies L-S32-1 doctrine surfaced at S32 Track A pivot (master-plan recommended A2 vnstock alternate; empirical probe rejected A1+A2; A3 SSI direct httpx adopted instead).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- hook-diagnostics: Inspect hook event lifecycle (state machine + transcript cache + aggregator output) when triaging failed/stuck hooks or auditing self-awareness rollups. Use during sandwich-verifier review, drift investigation, or post-mortem when component-telemetry.jsonl + dispatch.jsonl + sessions-rollup.tsv need cross-checking.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- session-memory-l0-l1: Extract structured memories (L0 quick metadata + L1 deep) from a Claude Code session JSONL transcript. L0 is pure regex (file paths, commands, errors, failures incl. Vietnamese phrases, next step). L1 ships the prompt builder + response parser + 15+35 head/tail windowing — caller dispatches the LLM (no auto-invoke in Phase 0). Plus cleanText harness-stripper + TranscriptCache (mtime+size dual-check + LRU). Use when ingesting a session for memory promotion, computing what files/commands/failures the session touched, or preparing an offline LLM extraction.\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\n\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\n\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\n|---|---|---|\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). Append-only mostly. | Long-lived |\n| `memory/decisions/` | Sequential ADRs (`NNN-<slug>.md`) + `_template.md` + `README.md` index. 12-field schema (Track 2). | Append-only; supersession via status field |\n| `memory/sessions/` | One file per session: `YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`. What happened, decisions made, files touched. | Append-only |\n| `memory/observations/` | Subagent return artifacts (per Track 6 spec). Each subagent writes one observation file describing what it did. | Append; cleaned periodically by aggregator |\n| `memory/checkpoints/` | Session handoff state for self-reboot (Track 5). `latest.md` is canonical pointer; timestamped historical files retained. | Append + latest.md updated each checkpoint |\n| `memory/patterns-discovered/` | Pattern mining outputs (Track 0 — DONE) + ongoing pattern catalog. | Append; significant patterns promoted to constitution |\n| `memory/drift-logs/` | Drift-check (DR1-DR12) results; runs on hook + on-demand. | Time-series append |\n| `memory/post-mortems/` | After significant failure or thesis-revoked event: what failed, root cause, prevention rule. | Append |\n| `memory/thesis-log/` | Stock-domain thesis exploration entries. Read-only for IMPL sessions. | Append + revisited per calibration |\n| `memory/sync-tracker/` | Track 8a output: Confidence Score SQLite + weights.yaml + auto-rendered `_index.md`. | Live updated by hooks |\n| `memory/self-awareness/` | Track 9 output: model × effort × thinking profile cards + known-issues + best-practices. | Live updated by Stop-hook aggregator |\n| `memory/mistake-log.md` | Track 7 deliverable: structured failure catalog. What went wrong / Root cause / Prevention rule / Severity. | Append; pre-flight read by all agents |\n| `session-plans/pending/` | Plans authored, awaiting execution. Phase 0 plan lives here. | Move to `completed/` when done |\n| `session-plans/completed/` | Executed plans; archived for reference + retrospective input. | Append |\n| `quality-reports/{deterministic,probabilistic,drift-reports}/` | Tier-1/2/3 gate outputs (CLAUDE.md § Quality Gates). | Per-run files |\n| `ubiquitous-language/` | DDD glossary + domain-mapping + drift-log. Stockforge stock-domain vocabulary. | Append; canonical via `/drill-me` |\n| `calibration/` | Empirical hit-rate data per signal type. Confidence claims MUST trace here (CLAUDE.md hard rule). | Append per thesis post-mortem |\n| `research/` | Research notes from `research-scanner` subagent dispatches (e.g., reference-repo studies). | Append |\n\n---\n\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\n\n1. **Constitution is immutable absent explicit human approval.** `Edit/Write` to `agent-workspace/constitution/**` is in `.claude/settings.json` deny list. Track 7 writes constitution drafts to `proposals/`; user explicit approve moves them.\n\n2. **`memory/decisions/` is append-mostly + supersession-status.** Don't delete decisions; mark `status: superseded-by-D-NNN` to revoke. Sequential numbering (`001`, `002`, ...) — don't reuse numbers.\n\n3. **`current-execution.md` is the routing source-of-truth.** No skill, agent, or command may hardcode phase paths or session paths from memory; resolve via this file. Stale paths in CLAUDE.md or skills = anti-pattern.\n\n4. **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. Vault writes only to `wiki/`. (Established in stockforge CLAUDE.md.)\n\n5. **Provenance is mandatory.** Every decision file references its source (human prompt / spec clause / drift detection / agent inference). Every thesis cites source + as-of date (I-S2). (Otherwise they're informal notes, not contracts.)\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nPer `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` (Track 7) and stockforge `CLAUDE.md` § Session Protocol:\n\n1. **`memory/current-execution.md`** — first; resolve active track\n2. **`memory/project.md`** — project state\n3. **`memory/checkpoints/latest.md`** if a recent checkpoint exists (within last 24h) — resume context\n4. **`memory/agent-notes.md`** — learned rules\n5. **`memory/mistake-log.md`** — pre-flight failure catalog\n6. **Last 3 files in `memory/sessions/`** — recent context\n7. **`session-plans/pending/<active-plan>.md`** — current plan\n8. **Relevant constitution files** as task demands (don't load all every session)\n9. **Relevant skills + agents + commands** as task demands\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns to Avoid\n\n(From `memory/patterns-discovered/SYNTHESIS.md` § 6, full catalog 23 items. Human's domain is `human-workspace/`. The two communicate through:\n- Human → Agent: `human-workspace/user_prompt/`, `human-workspace/decisions/`\n- Agent → Human: `human-workspace/notifications/`, `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/`\n- Bidirectional: `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/` — agent writes pending; either human or agent (per Auto-mv rule below) moves resolved bundles to answered/\n- Audit trail: this directory's `memory/decisions/` references `human-workspace/` source files via path pointers\n\n**Auto-mv rule (HH-E.2 — D-031 ratification, 2026-05-05)**: Agent MAY mv a bundle from `q-and-a/pending/` to `q-and-a/answered/` IFF ALL of the following hold:\n\n1. **Frontmatter signal**: bundle frontmatter `status:` field value starts with one of: `answered-`, `closed-`, `resolved-`. Direct manual `mv` invocation by agent (e.g. via Bash tool) is STILL forbidden — only the validated hook path is authorized.\n\nAgent never writes to `human-workspace/` outside the designated `q-and-a/pending/` write channel + the auto-mv rule above + `notifications/` write channel (existing).\n","contentDiffersFromDisk":false},"displayPath":"agent-workspace\\CLAUDE.md"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"3126d382-b3dd-4241-920e-cb286b93a104","timestamp":"2026-05-05T17:18:24.262Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"0c44c54b-ea6a-445d-a08b-5ed305027be3","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"9e4afb81-ac74-4df2-929f-5814be3311d5","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"39295ca9-8e65-4ccf-9806-1029969ec558","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01WZuvjw1pMybtprPSvsY5BB","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# PROJECT CHARTER\n2\t## StockForge — Personal Investment Advisor for Vietnamese Stock Market\n3\t\n4\t> **Status**: Immutable v1.0 — changes require explicit charter revision.\n5\t> **Scope of immutability**: Vision, principles, success criteria.\n6\t> **Things that do evolve**: Agent configs, specs, implementation, signal weights, eval sets.\n7\t\n8\t---\n9\t\n10\t## Vision\n11\t\n12\tAn AI-first investment research and advisory system that combines **quant fund methodology** with **Vietnam-specific edge sources** (KOL networks, crowd sentiment, pump pattern detection) to surface high-conviction opportunities in an inefficient market where logic-based screening alone is insufficient.\n13\t\n14\tPrimary user: project owner (self) + 3-5 trusted peers in Vietnamese investing community.\n15\t\n16\tPrimary goal: build a system that compounds edge over time through proprietary data accumulation, not through any single clever algorithm. After 12-24 months of dogfood, the system should be a genuine advisor I would pay money for if someone else built it.\n17\t\n18\tNot a goal: high-frequency trading, replacing human judgment, becoming a SaaS in Year 1, beating frontier LLMs at general reasoning, providing licensed financial advice.\n19\t\n20\t---\n21\t\n22\t## The Core Insight (the why)\n23\t\n24\t**Quant funds (Renaissance, Two Sigma, DE Shaw) win in efficient markets through clean data + execution speed + diverse alpha factors.** They don't use sentiment from Facebook/YouTube because at their scale it's noise, not signal — and in efficient markets it gets arbitraged away anyway.\n25\t\n26\t**Vietnam stock market inverts this.** It is structurally inefficient:\n27\t- 85-90% retail investor share (vs 20-25% in US)\n28\t- Information asymmetry between sophisticated and retail crowd\n29\t- KOL/influencer recommendations measurably move prices\n30\t- \"Đội lái\" (pump operators) operate openly\n31\t- News and narrative cycles dominate over fundamentals for months at a time\n32\t- Foreign flow creates non-fundamental price pressure\n33\t\n34\tIn this market, **sentiment + influence + narrative tracking is signal, not noise**. And LLMs can process Vietnamese unstructured text at scale that was impossible before 2023.\n35\t\n36\tThis creates a **structural arbitrage**: apply quant methodology + LLM reasoning + sentiment/influence data layers that no commercial product offers for VN. Position not as \"decision maker\" but as **advisor + alert watcher + bias mirror**.\n37\t\n38\t---\n39\t\n40\t## The Craft Philosophy\n41\t\n42\tTake the craft seriously. Build for personal use first, commercial second.\n43\t\n44\t- Production-grade engineering standards from Day 1 (DDD + clean architecture + multi-loop discipline)\n45\t- Commercial extension kept as option, never as driver\n46\t- When self-use conflicts with hypothetical-future-SaaS, self-use wins\n47\t- Quality bar: I genuinely trust output enough to act on real money decisions\n48\t- Edge comes from compounding moats (proprietary data, calibration, personal bias log), not from any single feature\n49\t\n50\tReference models: Renaissance Technologies (data + iteration discipline), Bridgewater (principles-based decision making), personal Bloomberg Terminal (data density + analysis depth), Athletic.com (subscription-quality content for niche audience).\n51\t\n52\t---\n53\t\n54\t## Core Principles (non-negotiable)\n55\t\n56\t1. **Evidence grounding** — every claim, every number traceable to source + as-of date. Hallucination in finance = bug, not stylistic issue.\n57\t\n58\t2. **Structured output over narrative** — multi-criteria assessment, never single \"buy/sell\" score. Output is trade-off matrix.\n59\t\n60\t3. **Adversarial by design** — bear + bull + critic + quant + behavior + manager perspectives. Never consensus from single agent.\n61\t\n62\t4. **Proprietary data moat** — every news ingested, every KOL recommendation tracked, every thesis post-mortem'd compounds the edge. Raw data is sacred.\n63\t\n64\t5. **Pattern transfer + local adaptation** — global setups (cyclical bottom, dividend value, GARP) + Vietnam-specific overlays (policy timing, foreign flow, narrative phase).\n65\t\n66\t6. **Human-in-loop is the product** — augment thinking, never replace it. System should challenge user's gut instinct without overriding it.\n67\t\n68\t7. **Dogfood mandatory** — if I don't use it weekly for real decisions, the feature gets killed. Self-use is the only validation that matters in Year 1.\n69\t\n70\t8. **Calibration over confidence** — system tracks its own accuracy across signal types, never claims confidence it hasn't earned through hit rate.\n71\t\n72\t9. **No LLM math** — LLM never generates numbers. All calculations through deterministic code with verified data inputs. LLM only interprets.\n73\t\n74\t10. **Position sizing & risk management are deterministic** — code-enforced rules, LLM cannot override. Maximum position size, sector concentration, stop loss rules are immutable per session.\n75\t\n76\t---\n77\t\n78\t## The Four-Tier Signal Architecture\n79\t\n80\tSystem operates on four distinct signal tiers, each with different lead time, reliability, and processing approach:\n81\t\n82\t**Tier 1 — Hard Data (deterministic):** prices, volumes, fundamentals, foreign flow, macro indicators. Zero LLM, pure code. Lead time: hours-days.\n83\t\n84\t**Tier 2 — Official Narrative (semi-structured):** mainstream financial news, broker reports, official company disclosures, government announcements. LLM extracts claims + classifies sentiment + detects contradictions. Lead time: real-time.\n85\t\n86\t**Tier 3 — Influence Network (semi-structured):** YouTube channels, Facebook KOL pages, Telegram channels, podcasts. LLM transcribes + extracts recommendations + tags entities. Calibration database tracks each KOL's accuracy over time. Lead time: can lead by days.\n87\t\n88\t**Tier 4 — Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (unstructured):** community forums, public chat groups, comments. LLM classifies sentiment + detects coordinated posting + identifies pump narratives + tracks narrative lifecycle phase. Lead time: typically lags price (signals exhaustion).\n89\t\n90\tThe combination — when Tier 1+2+3 agree before Tier 4 heats up = early opportunity; when Tier 4 hot but Tier 1+2 don't support = likely top — is the core analytical edge.\n91\t\n92\tSee `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` for detailed tier specs.\n93\t\n94\t---\n95\t\n96\t## First Sub-Scope (locked 6 months)\n97\t\n98\t**Vietnam stocks listed on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM**, specifically:\n99\t- VN30 + mid-cap (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) for primary coverage\n100\t- Long-only equity strategies (no derivatives, no shorting)"}]},"uuid":"a3f58764-1ca0-43b7-b067-b1bfdc059d6e","timestamp":"2026-05-05T17:18:30.620Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\PROJECT_CHARTER.md","content":"# PROJECT CHARTER\n## StockForge — Personal Investment Advisor for Vietnamese Stock Market\n\n> **Status**: Immutable v1.0 — changes require explicit charter revision.\n> **Scope of immutability**: Vision, principles, success criteria.\n> **Things that do evolve**: Agent configs, specs, implementation, signal weights, eval sets.\n\n---\n\n## Vision\n\nAn AI-first investment research and advisory system that combines **quant fund methodology** with **Vietnam-specific edge sources** (KOL networks, crowd sentiment, pump pattern detection) to surface high-conviction opportunities in an inefficient market where logic-based screening alone is insufficient.\n\nPrimary user: project owner (self) + 3-5 trusted peers in Vietnamese investing community.\n\nPrimary goal: build a system that compounds edge over time through proprietary data accumulation, not through any single clever algorithm. {"parentUuid":"8a5330cb-8197-4a2b-b8e8-c849bea51b70","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"39295ca9-8e65-4ccf-9806-1029969ec558","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_016tKUswSzdwmdYdDLHRPwhd","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t---\n2\tspec_id: SPEC-2026-04-23-003\n3\ttier: 2\n4\tstatus: approved\n5\tversion: 1.0\n6\tcreated: 2026-04-23\n7\tauthors: [project-owner]\n8\tbounded_contexts: [Crowd Sentiment]\n9\trelated_specs: [SPEC-2026-04-23-T1-001, SPEC-2026-04-23-004]\n10\tubiquitous_language_terms: [Crowd Sentiment, Narrative, Narrative Phase, Pump Phase, Coordination Score, Mention Velocity, Posting Pattern, FOMO, Distribution, Counter-Narrative]\n11\t---\n12\t\n13\t# SPEC: Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (BC-7)\n14\t\n15\t> Implements Tier 4 of the four-tier signal architecture.\n16\t> Most Vietnam-specific edge — no commercial product tracks crowd behavior at this depth.\n17\t\n18\t---\n19\t\n20\t# PART A — BUSINESS SPECIFICATION\n21\t\n22\t## A.1 Context\n23\t\n24\tVietnam stock market has an active online retail community: F319 forum, Facebook public groups with 50K-500K members, Telegram channels, comment sections on CafeF/Vietstock. This community's collective behavior follows patterns:\n25\t\n26\t- **Narratives have lifecycles** (incubation → emerging → mainstream → saturation → exhaustion → reversal). Trading the narrative at right phase = alpha; buying at saturation = losses.\n27\t\n28\t- **Pumps follow signatures**. Pump operators (\"đội lái\") don't vary their playbook much: quiet accumulation → narrative seeding through proxy accounts → sudden volume + price spike → KOL amplification → retail FOMO → distribution → dump. Each phase has detectable features.\n29\t\n30\t- **Coordinated posting is detectable**. Same talking points, similar phrasing, clustered timing across supposedly independent accounts = coordinated messaging. LLMs can detect this at scale that humans cannot.\n31\t\n32\t- **Crowd sentiment LAGS price**. By the time community is euphoric, the move is often 80% done. By the time despair sets in, bottom often forming. Sentiment is **timing signal for narrative phases**, not directional signal.\n33\t\n34\tMajor commercial products (FiinPro, Wichart, Stockbiz) don't provide this. It's labor-intensive and requires Vietnamese NLP — exactly what LLMs now enable.\n35\t\n36\t## A.2 Core Use Cases\n37\t\n38\t**UC-1 Pump Warning** — Alert when ticker shows pump signature: alert specifies suspected phase (pre-pump / pump / distribution / dump) with contributing signals and recommended action (avoid / exit / continue watching).\n39\t\n40\t**UC-2 Narrative Tracking** — Track narratives (e.g., \"đầu tư công 2026\", \"ngành thép phục hồi\") through lifecycle phases. Alert when narrative reaches saturation (likely top forming).\n41\t\n42\t**UC-3 Counter-Narrative Generator** — When a ticker reaches high sentiment (>80% bullish community), system auto-generates counter-narrative: what if this is wrong, what are bear cases, historical similar setups that failed.\n43\t\n44\t**UC-4 Sentiment Momentum on Watchlist** — Daily: which of my watchlist stocks have meaningful sentiment changes? (Crowd suddenly notices = late; crowd turning negative on one I own = signal.)\n45\t\n46\t**UC-5 FOMO Detection** — Detect when I'm about to FOMO — if I'm querying a ticker that's currently in saturation phase with high pump signals, system reminds me of pattern.\n47\t\n48\t## A.3 Business Rules\n49\t\n50\t**BR-1 Public Only** — Forums (F319 public section), public Facebook groups (non-restricted), public Telegram channels, article comments. **NEVER private groups, never Zalo private, never DMs.**\n51\t\n52\t**BR-2 Respect Rate Limits** — Every scraper has declared RPM cap; source-specific polite user agent identifying as research tool with contact.\n53\t\n54\t**BR-3 Aggregate, Don't Store Individuals** — Individual posts retained only for labeled training data + random sample for debugging. Aggregate metrics retained forever. (Privacy + storage cost + legal hygiene.)\n55\t\n56\t**BR-4 Vietnamese Sentiment Categorical** — Sentiment scored categorically (STRONGLY_BULLISH | BULLISH | NEUTRAL | BEARISH | STRONGLY_BEARISH). Never numeric \"80% bullish\" from LLM (I-S1 + Rule 7).\n57\t\n58\t**BR-5 Pump Detection Must Be Backtest-Validated** — Rules tested on historical labeled pumps before going live. Minimum precision > 0.5, recall > 0.3 on hold-out.\n59\t\n60\t**BR-6 Counter-Narrative Mandatory for Hot Stocks** — When community sentiment >80% bullish on a ticker we're considering, system MUST produce counter-narrative before any positive signal issued (I-S13).\n61\t\n62\t**BR-7 Narrative Phase Transitions Event-Driven** — Each narrative has phase; transitions trigger events and alerts. Phases don't skip (INCUBATION → EMERGING → MAINSTREAM → SATURATION → EXHAUSTION → REVERSAL).\n63\t\n64\t**BR-8 Coordination Score Conservative** — Coordination detection has high threshold (0.8+) before flagging to avoid false accusations. Flagged ≠ confirmed pump; requires human review.\n65\t\n66\t**BR-9 Historical Pattern Matching Required** — Every pump detection references historical similar cases. If no historical analog, flag as \"novel pattern, low confidence\".\n67\t\n68\t**BR-10 No Public Accusations** — System output frames as \"pattern detected, exercise caution\" — never names specific operators or accuses. Legal safety.\n69\t\n70\t## A.4 Success Criteria\n71\t\n72\t**Month 6**:\n73\t- Sentiment tracking for top 100 stocks operational\n74\t- 5+ labeled historical pumps in training set\n75\t- First pump warning issued before broad retail recognition\n76\t- First narrative tracked through full lifecycle\n77\t\n78\t**Month 9**:\n79\t- Pump detection precision >0.5 on hold-out\n80\t- 15+ narratives tracked; 3+ completed full lifecycle\n81\t- Counter-narrative generator routinely catches over-enthusiasm\n82\t\n83\t**Month 12**:\n84\t- Documented case: system warned me about pump I was considering\n85\t- Documented case: system detected narrative shift before I noticed\n86\t- Crowd sentiment integrates into thesis validation (BC-8)\n87\t\n88\t**Qualitative**:\n89\t- I genuinely delay FOMO decisions because system shows late phase\n90\t- Counter-narratives have changed at least 2 decisions\n91\t- I trust pump warnings enough to act on them (usually: avoid)\n92\t\n93\t## A.5 Out of Scope\n94\t\n95\t- Individual post content analysis beyond aggregation\n96\t- Targeting specific individuals (no naming, no accusations)\n97\t- Real-time stream processing (hourly batch acceptable Phase 1-2)\n98\t- Non-Vietnamese sentiment (English later)\n99\t- Predicting price direction from sentiment alone\n100\t\n101\t---\n102\t\n103\t# PART B — AGENT CONTRACT\n104\t\n105\t## B.1 Key Domain Model\n106\t\n107\t```python\n108\t# packages/domain/crowd/models/\n109\t\n110\tclass Sentiment(Enum):\n111\t    STRONGLY_BULLISH = \"strongly_bullish\"\n112\t    BULLISH = \"bullish\"\n113\t    NEUTRAL = \"neutral\"\n114\t    BEARISH = \"bearish\"\n115\t    STRONGLY_BEARISH = \"strongly_bearish\"\n116\t\n117\tclass NarrativePhase(Enum):\n118\t    INCUBATION = \"incubation\"       # first mentions, few\n119\t    EMERGING = \"emerging\"           # velocity rising, not mainstream yet\n120\t    MAINSTREAM = \"mainstream\"       # major KOLs + news covering\n121\t    SATURATION = \"saturation\"       # everyone knows, no new bulls to convert\n122\t    EXHAUSTION = \"exhaustion\"       # velocity declining despite mentions\n123\t    REVERSAL = \"reversal\"           # counter-narrative emerging\n124\t    DEAD = \"dead\"                   # no more mentions\n125\t\n126\tclass PumpPhase(Enum):\n127\t    PRE_PUMP = \"pre_pump\"           # low-volume accumulation, whispers\n128\t    PUMP = \"pump\"                   # volume + price spike, narrative seeding\n129\t    DISTRIBUTION = \"distribution\"   # high volume flat price, novice posts\n130\t    DUMP = \"dump\"                   # price crash, narrative shift to confused\n131\t    UNCERTAIN = \"uncertain\"\n132\t\n133\t@dataclass\n134\tclass SentimentSnapshot:\n135\t    \"\"\"Aggregate sentiment for a ticker over a time window.\"\"\"\n136\t    snapshot_id: str\n137\t    ticker: Ticker\n138\t    captured_at: datetime\n139\t    window: Window  # 1H | 4H | 1D | 1W\n140\t    mention_count: int\n141\t    sentiment_distribution: dict[Sentiment, int]  # counts per category\n142\t    posting_velocity: float         # posts/hour\n143\t    unique_posters: int\n144\t    coordinated_posting_score: float # 0-1, template/timing similarity\n145\t    sources: dict[str, int]         # source -> mention count\n146\t    top_terms: list[str]            # most common phrases\n147\t    source_posts_sample: list[str]  # This community's collective behavior follows patterns:\n\n- **Narratives have lifecycles** (incubation → emerging → mainstream → saturation → exhaustion → reversal). Trading the narrative at right phase = alpha; buying at saturation = losses.\n\n- **Pumps follow signatures**. Pump operators (\"đội lái\") don't vary their playbook much: quiet accumulation → narrative seeding through proxy accounts → sudden volume + price spike → KOL amplification → retail FOMO → distribution → dump. Each phase has detectable features.\n\n- **Coordinated posting is detectable**. Same talking points, similar phrasing, clustered timing across supposedly independent accounts = coordinated messaging. LLMs can detect this at scale that humans cannot.\n\n- **Crowd sentiment LAGS price**. By the time community is euphoric, the move is often 80% done. By the time despair sets in, bottom often forming. Sentiment is **timing signal for narrative phases**, not directional signal.\n\nMajor commercial products (FiinPro, Wichart, Stockbiz) don't provide this. It's labor-intensive and requires Vietnamese NLP — exactly what LLMs now enable.\n\n## A.2 Core Use Cases\n\n**UC-1 Pump Warning** — Alert when ticker shows pump signature: alert specifies suspected phase (pre-pump / pump / distribution / dump) with contributing signals and recommended action (avoid / exit / continue watching).\n\n**UC-2 Narrative Tracking** — Track narratives (e.g., \"đầu tư công 2026\", \"ngành thép phục hồi\") through lifecycle phases. Alert when narrative reaches saturation (likely top forming).\n\n**UC-3 Counter-Narrative Generator** — When a ticker reaches high sentiment (>80% bullish community), system auto-generates counter-narrative: what if this is wrong, what are bear cases, historical similar setups that failed.\n\n**UC-4 Sentiment Momentum on Watchlist** — Daily: which of my watchlist stocks have meaningful sentiment changes? (Crowd suddenly notices = late; crowd turning negative on one I own = signal.)\n\n**UC-5 FOMO Detection** — Detect when I'm about to FOMO — if I'm querying a ticker that's currently in saturation phase with high pump signals, system reminds me of pattern.\n\n## A.3 Business Rules\n\n**BR-1 Public Only** — Forums (F319 public section), public Facebook groups (non-restricted), public Telegram channels, article comments. **NEVER private groups, never Zalo private, never DMs.**\n\n**BR-2 Respect Rate Limits** — Every scraper has declared RPM cap; source-specific polite user agent identifying as research tool with contact.\n\n**BR-3 Aggregate, Don't Store Individuals** — Individual posts retained only for labeled training data + random sample for debugging. Aggregate metrics retained forever. (Privacy + storage cost + legal hygiene.)\n\n**BR-4 Vietnamese Sentiment Categorical** — Sentiment scored categorically (STRONGLY_BULLISH | BULLISH | NEUTRAL | BEARISH | STRONGLY_BEARISH). Never numeric \"80% bullish\" from LLM (I-S1 + Rule 7).\n\n**BR-5 Pump Detection Must Be Backtest-Validated** — Rules tested on historical labeled pumps before going live. Minimum precision > 0.5, recall > 0.3 on hold-out.\n\n**BR-6 Counter-Narrative Mandatory for Hot Stocks** — When community sentiment >80% bullish on a ticker we're considering, system MUST produce counter-narrative before any positive signal issued (I-S13).\n\n**BR-7 Narrative Phase Transitions Event-Driven** — Each narrative has phase; transitions trigger events and alerts. Phases don't skip (INCUBATION → EMERGING → MAINSTREAM → SATURATION → EXHAUSTION → REVERSAL).\n\n**BR-8 Coordination Score Conservative** — Coordination detection has high threshold (0.8+) before flagging to avoid false accusations. Flagged ≠ confirmed pump; requires human review.\n\n**BR-9 Historical Pattern Matching Required** — Every pump detection references historical similar cases. If no historical analog, flag as \"novel pattern, low confidence\".\n\n**BR-10 No Public Accusations** — System output frames as \"pattern detected, exercise caution\" — never names specific operators or accuses. Legal safety.\n\n## A.4 Success Criteria\n\n**Month 6**:\n- Sentiment tracking for top 100 stocks operational\n- 5+ labeled historical pumps in training set\n- First pump warning issued before broad retail recognition\n- First narrative tracked through full lifecycle\n\n**Month 9**:\n- Pump detection precision >0.5 on hold-out\n- 15+ narratives tracked; 3+ completed full lifecycle\n- Counter-narrative generator routinely catches over-enthusiasm\n\n**Month 12**:\n- Documented case: system warned me about pump I was considering\n- Documented case: system detected narrative shift before I noticed\n- Crowd sentiment integrates into thesis validation (BC-8)\n\n**Qualitative**:\n- I genuinely delay FOMO decisions because system shows late phase\n- Counter-narratives have changed at least 2 decisions\n- I trust pump warnings enough to act on them (usually: avoid)\n\n## A.5 Out of Scope\n\n- Individual post content analysis beyond aggregation\n- Targeting specific individuals (no naming, no accusations)\n- Real-time stream processing (hourly batch acceptable Phase 1-2)\n- Non-Vietnamese sentiment (English later)\n- Predicting price direction from sentiment alone\n\n---\n\n# PART B — AGENT CONTRACT\n\n## B.1 Key Domain Model\n\n```python\n# packages/domain/crowd/models/\n\nclass Sentiment(Enum):\n    STRONGLY_BULLISH = \"strongly_bullish\"\n    BULLISH = \"bullish\"\n    NEUTRAL = \"neutral\"\n    BEARISH = \"bearish\"\n    STRONGLY_BEARISH = \"strongly_bearish\"\n\nclass NarrativePhase(Enum):\n    INCUBATION = \"incubation\"       # first mentions, few\n    EMERGING = \"emerging\"           # velocity rising, not mainstream yet\n    MAINSTREAM = \"mainstream\"       # major KOLs + news covering\n    SATURATION = \"saturation\"       # everyone knows, no new bulls to convert\n    EXHAUSTION = \"exhaustion\"       # velocity declining despite mentions\n    REVERSAL = \"reversal\"           # counter-narrative emerging\n    DEAD = \"dead\"                   # no more mentions\n\nclass PumpPhase(Enum):\n    PRE_PUMP = \"pre_pump\"           # low-volume accumulation, whispers\n    PUMP = \"pump\"                   # volume + price spike, narrative seeding\n    DISTRIBUTION = \"distribution\"   # high volume flat price, novice posts\n    DUMP = \"dump\"                   # price crash, narrative shift to confused\n    UNCERTAIN = \"uncertain\"\n\n@dataclass\nclass SentimentSnapshot:\n    \"\"\"Aggregate sentiment for a ticker over a time window.\"\"\"\n    snapshot_id: str\n    ticker: Ticker\n    captured_at: datetime\n    window: Window  # 1H | 4H | 1D | 1W\n    mention_count: int\n    sentiment_distribution: dict[Sentiment, int]  # counts per category\n    posting_velocity: float         # posts/hour\n    unique_posters: int\n    coordinated_posting_score: float # 0-1, template/timing similarity\n    sources: dict[str, int]         # source -> mention count\n    top_terms: list[str]            # most common phrases\n    source_posts_sample: list[str]  # max 20 sample IDs for debugging\n\n    def dominant_sentiment(self) -> Sentiment:\n        return max(self.sentiment_distribution.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])[0]","numLines":150,"startLine":1,"totalLines":680}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8a5330cb-8197-4a2b-b8e8-c849bea51b70","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"0c44c54b-ea6a-445d-a08b-5ed305027be3","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

captured_at, dominant_sentiment, mention_count)\n210\tNarrativeEmerged(narrative_id, description, affected_tickers, first_detected_at)\n211\tNarrativePhaseChanged(narrative_id, from_phase, to_phase, affected_tickers, transitioned_at)\n212\tPumpPhaseDetected(detection_id, ticker, phase, phase_confidence, detected_at)\n213\tCoordinatedPostingDetected(ticker, posting_pattern, coordination_score, B.3 Core Use Cases\n219\t\n220\t### UC-1: Capture Sentiment Snapshot\n221\t\n222\t```python\n223\tclass CaptureSentimentSnapshotUseCase:\n224\t    \"\"\"Every N hours: aggregate new posts for tracked tickers into snapshot.\"\"\"\n225\t\n226\t    async def execute(self, ticker: Ticker, window: Window) -> SentimentSnapshot:\n227\t        from_time = datetime.utcnow() - window.duration\n228\t        raw_posts = await self.post_aggregator.fetch_recent(ticker, from_time)\n229\t\n230\t        # LLM sentiment classification (categorical, batched)\n231\t        classified = await self.sentiment_classifier.classify_batch(raw_posts)\n232\t\n233\t        # Coordination detection\n234\t        coord_score = self.coordination_detector.score(\n235\t            posts=classified,\n236\t            features=[TEMPLATE_SIMILARITY, TIMING_CLUSTER, ACCOUNT_AGE_DISTRIBUTION],\n237\t        )\n238\t\n239\t        # Aggregate (deterministic, no LLM for numbers)\n240\t        dist = defaultdict(int)\n241\t        sources = defaultdict(int)\n242\t        for post in classified:\n243\t            dist[post.sentiment] += 1\n244\t            sources[post.source] += 1\n245\t\n246\t        snapshot = SentimentSnapshot(\n247\t            snapshot_id=new_id(),\n248\t            ticker=ticker,\n249\t            captured_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n250\t            window=window,\n251\t            mention_count=len(classified),\n252\t            sentiment_distribution=dict(dist),\n253\t            posting_velocity=len(classified) / window.hours,\n254\t            unique_posters=len({p.poster_id for p in classified}),\n255\t            coordinated_posting_score=coord_score,\n256\t            sources=dict(sources),\n257\t            top_terms=self._extract_top_terms(classified),\n258\t            source_posts_sample=[p.post_id for p in random.sample(classified, min(20, len(classified)))],\n259\t        )\n260\t        await self.snapshot_repo.save(snapshot)\n261\t        await self.event_bus.publish(SentimentSnapshotCaptured(...))\n262\t\n263\t        if coord_score >= 0.8:\n264\t            await self.event_bus.publish(CoordinatedPostingDetected(\n265\t                ticker=ticker, posting_pattern=self._describe_pattern(classified),\n266\t                coordination_score=coord_score, detected_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n267\t            ))\n268\t        return snapshot\n269\t```\n270\t\n271\t### UC-2: Update Narrative Lifecycle\n272\t\n273\t```python\n274\tclass UpdateNarrativeLifecycleUseCase:\n275\t    \"\"\"Re-evaluate each active narrative: has phase changed?\"\"\"\n276\t\n277\t    async def execute(self) -> list[PhaseTransition]:\n278\t        active_narratives = await self.narrative_repo.get_active()\n279\t        transitions = []\n280\t        for narrative in active_narratives:\n281\t            new_phase = await self._compute_current_phase(narrative)\n282\t            if new_phase != narrative.current_phase:\n283\t                transition = PhaseTransition(\n284\t accounts\n483\t\n484\t**Historical analog finder** (`packages/infrastructure/crowd/analogs/`):\n485\t- Setup fingerprint: (price_trajectory + sentiment_shape + fundamental_state)\n486\t- Embedding-based similarity search on historical ticker-periods\n487\t- Returns top-K with subsequent outcomes attached\n488\t\n489\t## B.5 Database Schema (key tables)\n490\t\n491\t```sql\n492\t-- db/migrations/007_crowd_sentiment.sql\n493\t\n494\t-- TimescaleDB hypertable for sentiment snapshots\n495\tCREATE TABLE sentiment_snapshots (\n496\t    snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n497\t    ticker TEXT 'agent_with_review'\n562\t    labeled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()\n563\t);\n564\t```\n565\t\n566\t## B.6 Update Cadences\n567\t\n568\t- **Forum scraping**: every 30 min\n569\t- **FB group scraping**: every 2h\n570\t- **Telegram scraping**: every 1h\n571\t- **Comments scraping**: with parent article fetch (Tier 2 cycle)\n572\t- **Sentiment snapshot aggregation**: top 100 tickers every 1h, others every 4h\n573\t- **Narrative phase update**: every 4h\n574\t- **Pump detection scan**: every 2h during market days\n575\t- **Counter-narrative trigger**: event-driven on sentiment threshold crossing\n576\t- **Historical pattern backfill**: nightly\n577\t\n578\t## B.7 Training & Calibration\n579\t\n580\t**Labeled pump dataset** (seeded manually):\n581\t- User labels 10-20 historical pump events from memory (2021-2024 VN market)\n582\t- For each: start/end dates, phase transitions, tickers involved, subsequent outcome\n583\t- Stored in `eval-sets/labeled-pumps/`\n584\t- Used to validate pump classifier precision/recall\n585\t\n586\t**Sentiment classifier calibration**:\n587\t- Hand-label 200 posts for sentiment\n588\t- Run classifier, measure per-label accuracy\n589\t- If <85% per category, iterate on prompt\n590\t\n591\t**Narrative phase classifier calibration**:\n592\t- Trace 5 historical narratives through their lifecycle\n593\t- Compare classifier phases to ground truth\n594\t- Tune thresholds until ≥80% agreement\n595\t\n596\t## B.8 Quality Gates\n597\t\n598\t**Deterministic**:\n599\t- Sentiment returns enum only (schema enforces)\n600\t- Coordination score in [0,1]\n601\t- Pump confidence in [0,1]\n602\t- Bootstrap test: run same data twice, identical classifications\n603\t\n604\t**Probabilistic** (separate agent):\n605\t- Sample 2% of sentiment classifications for human review\n606\t- Pump detection cases all go to manual review first 3 months\n607\t- Counter-narrative quality: reviewed before delivered to user\n608\t\n609\t**Human**:\n610\t- Every pump detection in Phase 1 reviewed by user before alert fires\n611\t- Monthly: review false positives, add to training data\n612\t- Quarterly: recalibrate narrative classifier thresholds\n613\t\n614\t## B.9 Tasks (initial breakdown)\n615\t\n616\t**Phase 1** (foundation, ~4 weeks):\n617\t- Post aggregators for F319 + 2 major FB public groups\n618\t- LlmSentimentClassifier with calibration dataset\n619\t- SentimentSnapshot aggregation pipeline\n620\t- Basic dashboard showing ticker sentiment\n621\t\n622\t**Phase 2** (narrative tracking, ~3 weeks):\n623\t- Narrative detection + lifecycle classifier\n624\t- Phase transition events + history\n625\t- Narrative browser UI\n626\t- Backfill 5 historical narratives\n627\t\n628\t**Phase 3** (pump detection, ~4 weeks):\n629\t- Coordination detector\n630\t- Historical pump labeling (user + agent assist)\n631\t- PumpPhaseClassifier with backtest validation\n632\t- Historical analog finder\n633\t\n634\t**Phase 4** (counter-narrative, ~2 weeks):\n635\t- CounterNarrativeGenerator with grounded LLM\n636\t- Integration with thesis validation (BC-8)\n637\t- UI for reviewing counter-narratives\n638\t\n639\t## B.10 Risks & Mitigations\n640\t\n641\t| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |\n642\t|---|---|---|---|\n643\t| Pump operators evolve patterns | HIGH | HIGH | Continuous training data refresh, multi-signal (one signal insufficient), don't publicize detection logic |\n644\t| False accuse legitimate trader | MEDIUM | HIGH | Never name individuals; frame as            structural_risks=await self.risk_repo.get_sector_risks(ticker),\n        )\n\n        counter = CounterNarrative(\n            ticker=ticker,\n            generated_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n            trigger=trigger,\n            bear_points=bear_points,\n            historical_analogs=analogs,\n            failing_analog_details=failing_analogs,\n            bullish_consensus_summary=bullish_points,\n        )\n        await self.counter_repo.save(counter)\n        await self.event_bus.publish(CounterNarrativeGenerated(...))\n        return counter\n```\n\n## B.4 Infrastructure Adapters\n\n**Post aggregators** (`packages/infrastructure/crowd/aggregators/`):\n- `F319ForumAggregator` — F319 public sections\n- `FacebookPublicGroupAggregator` — Graph API for public groups only\n- `TelegramPublicChannelAggregator` — Bot API for public broadcast\n- `ArticleCommentsAggregator` — CafeF/Vietstock comments via scraping\n\n**Sentiment classifier** (`packages/infrastructure/crowd/sentiment/`):\n- `LlmSentimentClassifier` — Claude Haiku (cost-efficient for volume), categorical output\n- Batched: 50 posts per LLM call, output JSON array of sentiment labels\n\n**Coordination detector** (`packages/infrastructure/crowd/coordination/`):\n- Template similarity: embedding-based, flag if >10 posts with cosine similarity >0.9 within 1h\n- Timing cluster: flag if >5 accounts post within 3 minutes of each other repeatedly\n- Account age: flag if >50% of bullish posters are <30-day-old accounts\n\n**Historical analog finder** (`packages/infrastructure/crowd/analogs/`):\n- Setup fingerprint: (price_trajectory + sentiment_shape + fundamental_state)\n- Embedding-based similarity search on historical ticker-periods\n- Returns top-K with subsequent outcomes attached\n\n## B.5 Database Schema (key tables)\n\n```sql\n-- db/migrations/007_crowd_sentiment.sql\n\n-- TimescaleDB hypertable for sentiment snapshots\nCREATE TABLE sentiment_snapshots (\n    snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n    captured_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n    window TEXT NOT NULL,\n    mention_count INT NOT NULL,\n    sentiment_distribution JSONB NOT NULL,\n    posting_velocity REAL NOT NULL,\n    unique_posters INT NOT NULL,\n    coordinated_posting_score REAL NOT NULL,\n    sources JSONB NOT NULL,\n    top_terms TEXT[] NOT NULL,\n    PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_id, captured_at)\n);\nSELECT create_hypertable('sentiment_snapshots', 'captured_at');\nCREATE INDEX idx_snapshots_ticker_time ON sentiment_snapshots(ticker, captured_at DESC);\n\nCREATE TABLE narratives (\n    narrative_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    description TEXT NOT NULL,\n    thematic_keywords TEXT[] NOT NULL,\n    affected_tickers TEXT[] NOT NULL,\n    affected_sectors TEXT[] NOT NULL,\n    first_detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n    current_phase TEXT NOT NULL,\n    phase_history JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',\n    velocity_trend TEXT,\n    counter_narrative_ids TEXT[],\n    related_narrative_ids TEXT[]\n);\nCREATE INDEX idx_narratives_phase ON narratives(current_phase);\n\nCREATE TABLE pump_detections (\n    detection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n    detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n    phase TEXT NOT NULL,\n    phase_confidence REAL NOT NULL,\n    contributing_signals JSONB NOT NULL,\n    historical_similar_cases TEXT[],\n    recommended_action TEXT NOT NULL,\n    evidence_summary TEXT NOT NULL,\n    subsequent_outcome JSONB                -- filled post-hoc for calibration\n);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pumps_ticker_time ON pump_detections(ticker, detected_at DESC);\n\nCREATE TABLE counter_narratives (\n    counter_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n    generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n    trigger TEXT NOT NULL,\n    bear_points JSONB NOT NULL,\n    historical_analogs JSONB NOT NULL,\n    failing_analog_details JSONB NOT NULL,\n    bullish_consensus_summary TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- Labeled training set (hand-labeled by user + agent assistance)\nCREATE TABLE labeled_pumps (\n    label_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    ticker TEXT NOT NULL,\n    period_start DATE NOT NULL,\n    period_end DATE NOT NULL,\n    phases JSONB NOT NULL,                  -- [{phase, from_date, to_date}, ...]\n    features_at_detection JSONB NOT NULL,\n    subsequent_outcome JSONB NOT NULL,       -- return 30d/90d post-label\n    labeled_by TEXT NOT NULL,                -- 'user' | 'agent_with_review'\n    labeled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n```\n\n## B.6 Update Cadences\n\n- **Forum scraping**: every 30 min\n- **FB group scraping**: every 2h\n- **Telegram scraping**: every 1h\n- **Comments scraping**: with parent article fetch (Tier 2 cycle)\n- **Sentiment snapshot aggregation**: top 100 tickers every 1h, others every 4h\n- **Narrative phase update**: every 4h\n- **Pump detection scan**: every 2h during market days\n- **Counter-narrative trigger**: event-driven on sentiment threshold crossing\n- **Historical pattern backfill**: nightly\n\n## B.7 Training & Calibration\n\n**Labeled pump dataset** (seeded manually):\n- User labels 10-20 historical pump events from memory (2021-2024 VN market)\n- For each: start/end dates, phase transitions, tickers involved, subsequent outcome\n- Stored in `eval-sets/labeled-pumps/`\n- Used to validate pump classifier precision/recall\n\n**Sentiment classifier calibration**:\n- Hand-label 200 posts for sentiment\n- Run classifier, measure per-label accuracy\n- If <85% per category, iterate on prompt\n\n**Narrative phase classifier calibration**:\n- Trace 5 historical narratives through their lifecycle\n- Compare classifier phases to ground truth\n- Tune thresholds until ≥80% agreement\n\n## B.8 Quality Gates\n\n**Deterministic**:\n- Sentiment returns enum only (schema enforces)\n- Coordination score in [0,1]\n- Pump confidence in [0,1]\n- Bootstrap test: run same data twice, identical classifications\n\n**Probabilistic** (separate agent):\n- Sample 2% of sentiment classifications for human review\n- Pump detection cases all go to manual review first 3 months\n- Counter-narrative quality: reviewed before delivered to user\n\n**Human**:\n- Every pump detection in Phase 1 reviewed by user before alert fires\n- Monthly: review false positives, add to training data\n- Quarterly: recalibrate narrative classifier thresholds\n\n## B.9 Tasks (initial breakdown)\n\n**Phase 1** (foundation, ~4 weeks):\n- Post aggregators for F319 + 2 major FB public groups\n- LlmSentimentClassifier with calibration dataset\n- SentimentSnapshot aggregation pipeline\n- Basic dashboard showing ticker sentiment\n\n**Phase 2** (narrative tracking, ~3 weeks):\n- Narrative detection + lifecycle classifier\n- Phase transition events + history\n- Narrative browser UI\n- Backfill 5 historical narratives\n\n**Phase 3** (pump detection, ~4 weeks):\n- Coordination detector\n- Historical pump labeling (user + agent assist)\n- PumpPhaseClassifier with backtest validation\n- Historical analog finder\n\n**Phase 4** (counter-narrative, ~2 weeks):\n- CounterNarrativeGenerator with grounded LLM\n- Integration with thesis validation (BC-8)\n- UI for reviewing counter-narratives\n\n## B.10 Risks & Mitigations\n\n| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Pump operators evolve patterns | HIGH | HIGH | Continuous training data refresh, multi-signal (one signal insufficient), don't publicize detection logic |\n| False accuse legitimate trader | MEDIUM | HIGH | Never name individuals; frame as \"pattern detected, exercise caution\" |\n| Vietnamese sentiment accuracy <target | MEDIUM | MEDIUM | Curated training data, iterative prompt refinement, human sample review |\n| Legal/ToS issues with scraping | MEDIUM | HIGH | Public sources only, respect robots.txt, identify UA, polite rate limits, consult legal if unsure |\n| Low-quality historical labeled data | HIGH | MEDIUM | Start with user's personal memory, agent-assisted expansion, external reviewer |\n| Alerts too noisy, user ignores | HIGH | HIGH | Strict thresholds, historical precision requirement, human-review-first for Phase 1 |\n","numLines":200,"startLine":450,"totalLines":680}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2d8395ba-131f-4982-adf3-2bbee91943a9","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"0c44c54b-ea6a-445d-a08b-5ed305027be3","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

defer threshold-tightening to Year 2 outer-loop activation per spec 005\nchosen_options: A1 + B1 + C1 + D1 + E1 + F1 + G1 + H1 + I1\n---\n\n# D-028 — BC-7 Crowd Sentiment + Pump Detection Architecture\n\n> Ratifying ADR for BC-7 (Crowd Sentiment + Pump Detection) bounded-context architecture\n> covering Phase 3 Tracks J (3-source crowd ingestion + coordination feature extractor)\n> + K (narrative phase classifier + pump phase classifier + counter-narrative generator).\n> Sub-plan binding: `009-S51-track-J-K-impl-sub-plan.md`.\n\n## Context\n\nPhase 3 master-plan (007-S44) confirmed BC-7 full-scope ship via Q-P3-3 = ADD invariant\n(outer-loop activation gate) at S43f. Spec 003 (Tier 2) defines the entity model + use\ncases + business rules. D-026 ratified the LLM Substrate Boundary patterns at S43f+S43e\nmandating Track K cite the 3 patterns verbatim. D-027 (S45) committed parallel architecture\ndecisions for BC-6 — this BC-7 ADR mirrors D-027's structure verbatim where applicable\nand extends it for the 3 BC-7-specific decision domains (E narrative classifier, G counter-\nnarrative, H coordination detection, I backtest gate). This ADR commits the architectural\ndecisions for S52+S53 IMPL sessions.\n\nBC-7 is Tier 4 of the four-tier signal architecture and the most VN-specific edge — no\ncommercial product (FiinPro / Wichart / Stockbiz) tracks crowd behavior at this depth.\nImplementation depth carries proportional risk: BR-1 public-only enforcement, BR-10 no\npublic accusations, BR-5 backtest-validation gate before live deploy.\n\n## Decisions\n\n### (a) Storage substrate — SQLite extension\n\nMatch Phase 1+2+3 substrate (per L-S17-1 portability + D-027(a) precedent). Schema\nmirrors spec 003 § B.5 verbatim adapted for SQLite (TIMESTAMPTZ → TEXT ISO8601;\nJSONB → TEXT json-serialized; TEXT[] → TEXT json-array). TimescaleDB hypertable\nbehavior emulated via composite index `(ticker, captured_at DESC)` on\n`sentiment_snapshots` table; Phase 4 migration adds `create_hypertable()` call. Tables:\n`sentiment_snapshots`, `narratives`, `phase_transitions` (denormalized from\nnarratives.phase_history JSONB for query efficiency), `pump_detections`,\n`counter_narratives`, `labeled_pumps` per spec § B.5. Migration to Postgres+TimescaleDB\ndeferred to Phase 4 SaaS-deploy boundary. Substrate gain: zero new infra; consistent\nwith BC-5 (S36) + BC-6 (S46-S49) + BC-8 (S42) precedent. Rejected A2 Postgres-now\n(premature) + A3 hybrid (drift surface).\n\n### (b) Adapter pattern — Shared Protocol + 3 concrete impls\n\n`packages/application/crowd/ports/post_aggregator_port.py` defines `PostAggregator`\nProtocol with methods `fetch_recent(ticker, since) -> list[RawPost]` +\n`is_public(source_url) -> bool` + `respect_rate_limit() -> None`. Three concretes in\ninfrastructure: `f319_forum_aggregator.py`, `facebook_public_group_aggregator.py`,\n`article_comments_aggregator.py` (CafeF + Vietstock article-comment scrapers).\nShared `RateLimitedFetcher` base class encapsulates backoff + ToS pre-flight +\nuser-agent rotation (mirror BC-6 D-027(b) pattern; reuse module if importable from\ninfrastructure/influence_network/, else duplicate-with-attribution per Phase 3 BC-7\nneeds). Per R-P3-2 HIGH severity master-plan binding: crawler-reliability skill MANDATORY\nat S52 entry (mirrors S46 BC-6 entry). BR-1 public-only enforced at adapter layer:\neach `is_public()` returns False for known-private fixtures; private content raises\n`ToSBoundaryViolation` mirroring BC-6 telegram_adapter S64 fix-cycle hardening pattern\n(verifier-confirmed pattern at S64 close).\n\n**Telegram explicitly NOT included Phase 3 BC-7** — spec 003 § B.4 lists \"TelegramPublic-\nChannelAggregator\" but master-plan § Track Catalog J restricts to F319 + FacebookPublic-\nGroup + CafeF/Vietstock comments; Telegram crowd-sentiment deferred to Phase 4 (BC-6 S46\nalready ships TelegramPublicChannelAdapter for KOL signal — different use case). Document\nthis scoping decision as IMPL-S52-N at session entry per IMPL-S15-1 inline-document\ndoctrine.\n\nRejected B2 (duplicated boilerplate) + B3 (god-service).\n\n### (c) Domain aggregates persistence — Domain aggregates + Protocol repos\n\n`packages/domain/crowd/{sentiment_snapshot,narrative,phase_transition,pump_detection,counter_narrative,labeled_pump}.py`\nhold rich aggregates per spec 003 § B.1 — frozen dataclasses + `__post_init__`\ninvariants:\n- `SentimentSnapshot` requires sentiment_distribution dict non-empty + coordinated_posting_score in [0,1] + posting_velocity ≥ 0\n- `Narrative` requires non-empty thematic_keywords + current_phase NarrativePhase enum + first_detected_at not future\n- `PhaseTransition` requires from_phase != to_phase + transitioned_at not future\n- `PumpDetection` requires phase_confidence in [0,1] + non-empty contributing_signals + recommended_action PumpAction enum\n- `CounterNarrative` requires non-empty bear_points + at-least-one historical_analog\n- `LabeledPump` requires period_end > period_start + non-empty phases + labeled_by in {'user', 'agent_with_review'}\n\nBehaviors per spec § B.1: `SentimentSnapshot.dominant_sentiment()`, `bullish_ratio()`;\n`Narrative.days_in_current_phase()`. Protocol repos\n`packages/application/crowd/ports/{sentiment_snapshot,narrative,pump_detection,counter_narrative,labeled_pump}_repository.py`.\nConcrete `packages/infrastructure/crowd/sqlite_*_repository.py`.\n\nValue objects: `Sentiment` StrEnum (5 levels: STRONGLY_BULLISH | BULLISH | NEUTRAL |\nBEARISH | STRONGLY_BEARISH per BR-4); `NarrativePhase` StrEnum (7 levels per spec\n§ B.1 + DEAD); `PumpPhase` StrEnum (5 levels); `PumpAction` StrEnum (4 levels:\nAVOID | EXIT_IF_HOLDING | WATCH | INFORMATIONAL); `Window` StrEnum (4 levels: ONE_HOUR |\nFOUR_HOUR | ONE_DAY | ONE_WEEK with `hours` + `duration` properties).\n\nRejected C2 (anemic anti-pattern violates architecture.md § Domain Model Rules + spec\n§ B.1 rich-entity behaviors).\n\n### (d) LLM substrate boundary — D-026 verbatim citation\n\n`packages/infrastructure/crowd/sentiment_classifier.py` (LlmSentimentClassifier) +\n`packages/infrastructure/crowd/counter_narrative_generator.py` +\n`packages/infrastructure/crowd/pump_evidence_summarizer.py` all implement their respective\nports and cite architecture.md § \"LLM Substrate Boundary\" verbatim:\n\n- **Per-role override (BP-S43b-1)**: each adapter exposes `role_model_overrides` dict\n  allowing Haiku-batch (sentiment classifier — 50 posts/call cost-driven) vs\n  Sonnet-extract (counter-narrative — quality-driven) vs Opus-summary (pump evidence\n  rare-call quality-driven) hybrid without touching call sites.\n- **Prose-tolerant JSON (BP-S43b-2)**: 3-tier extractor (fenced block → first-`{`\n  heuristic → best-effort recovery); reuse `subagent_transport.py:55-118` extractor\n  function (Phase 2 BC-8 substrate; Phase 3 BC-6 S47 precedent).\n- **Gatherer-wired compute (BP-S43b-3)**: deterministic services prepare LLM context\n  — `CrowdContentGatherer` for sentiment classifier (post batching + window metadata),\n  `CounterNarrativeGatherer` for counter-narrative (HistoricalAnalogFinder results +\n  bullish_consensus + sector_risks), `PumpEvidenceGatherer` for pump summary (signals +\n  historical_matches). Numbers (timestamps, confidence floats, mention_counts,\n  posting_velocity, coordination_scores) come from code per I-S1; LLM ONLY outputs\n  text — categorical sentiment enum + bear-point prose + evidence-summary prose.\n\n**Critical I-S1 enforcement** per CLAUDE.md hard rule + invariants.md § I-S1: LLM\nNEVER outputs numeric. Sentiment classifier returns `Sentiment` enum 5-level (BR-4\nmandates categorical-only). Counter-narrative generator returns list of bear-point\nstrings. Pump evidence summarizer returns single string. Verifier grep gate at S52/S53\nclose: `grep -r \"anthropic\\|openai\\|claude_llm\" packages/domain/crowd/` returns 0;\nLLM-output JSON schema validation rejects any non-enum sentiment + any number-shaped\nfield in counter-narrative bear-points + any number-shaped field in pump evidence\nsummary.\n\nS52 entry MUST run empirical-probe-first (per L-S32-1 skill) on ≥3 strategies for\nsentiment classifier model pick: Claude Haiku batch / Claude Sonnet batch / Haiku-prefilter+\nSonnet-extract hybrid. Probe set = 50 hand-labeled VN forum posts (mix of F319 + FB\ngroup public posts). Pick by per-label accuracy (≥85% per category per § B.7\ncalibration target). Cost band: ~$3-6 one-time for 50-fixture × 3-strategy probe\n(sentiment classification much cheaper per-token than KOL extraction). Rejected D2\n(violates D-026 ratified) + D3 (violates I-S1 + BR-4).\n\n### (e) NarrativePhaseClassifier — Deterministic rule-based 7-state\n\n`packages/domain/crowd/services/narrative_phase_classifier.py` per UC-2 + spec § B.3\nlines 301-333. **DETERMINISTIC pure-Python; NO LLM**. 7-phase machine:\nINCUBATION → EMERGING → MAINSTREAM → SATURATION → EXHAUSTION → REVERSAL → DEAD.\nRules verbatim from spec § B.3 lines 301-333:\n\n```\nINCUBATION:   avg_mentions_per_day < 5 AND unique_sources < 3\nEMERGING:     velocity_trend == \"ACCELERATING\" AND major_source_share < 0.2\nMAINSTREAM:   major_source_share >= 0.3 AND kol_mention_count >= 3\nSATURATION:   MAINSTREAM context AND bullish_ratio >= 0.8 AND new_unique_posters_trend == \"DECELERATING\"\nEXHAUSTION:   avg_mentions_per_day >= 20 AND velocity_trend == \"DECELERATING\"\nREVERSAL:     counter_narrative_velocity > velocity * 0.3\nDEAD:         avg_mentions_per_day < 1\n```\n\nThresholds tunable via `NarrativePhaseClassifierConfig` dataclass (default values\nmatch spec § B.3 verbatim; tuning deferred to Year 2 outer-loop activation per spec\n005). Phase transitions emit `NarrativePhaseChanged` event per § B.2. Verifier grep\ngate at S53 close: `grep -r \"anthropic\\|openai\\|claude_llm\" packages/domain/crowd/services/`\nreturns 0. Rejected E2 (LLM declares phase — violates spec § C.1 explicit rejection\n+ I-S1) + E3 (ML model — insufficient labeled data Phase 3).\n\n### (f) PumpPhaseClassifier — Deterministic multi-signal weighted scoring\n\n`packages/domain/crowd/services/pump_phase_classifier.py` per UC-3 + spec § B.3\nlines 379-423. **DETERMINISTIC pure-Python; NO LLM**. 5-state classifier:\nPRE_PUMP / PUMP / DISTRIBUTION / DUMP / UNCERTAIN. Multi-signal weighted scoring:\n\n- **PRE_PUMP signals**: quiet_accumulation (price_change_30d < 0.10 + volume_30d_avg\n  rising) + kol_whispers_no_news (t3_kol_mentions_rising + t2_news_silent)\n- **PUMP signals**: volume_price_spike (price_5d_change > 0.20 + volume ratio >3x) +\n  fomo_active (t3_kol_mentions_peak + t4_novice_post_share > 0.5)\n- **DISTRIBUTION signals**: volume_without_price (volume ratio >2x + abs(price_5d_change)\n  < 0.05) + novice_fomo_dominant (t4_novice_post_share > 0.7 + t4_coordination_score < 0.3)\n- **DUMP signals**: price_crash_volume_decline (price_5d_change < -0.15 + volume declining)\n\nScoring weights per spec § B.3 verbatim (PRE_PUMP signals 0.3+0.3=0.6 max; PUMP\n0.4+0.3=0.7 max; etc.). Confidence gate ≥0.4 OR returns UNCERTAIN per spec line 418.\nWeight tuning deferred to Year 2 outer-loop activation per spec 005. Per § B.8\n\"Bootstrap test: run same data twice, identical classifications\" — pure-Python\nguarantees this; pytest deterministic-roundtrip test.\n\n**BR-9 historical pattern matching** binding: every detection cross-references via\n`HistoricalAnalogFinder` (decision (g) substrate); if no historical analog matches,\ndetection annotated `historical_similar_cases=[]` and confidence capped at 0.6 per\nBR-9 \"novel pattern, low confidence\" framing.\n\n**BR-5 backtest validation gate** per decision (i) below: precision >0.5 + recall >0.3\nhold-out gate at S53 close BEFORE classifier deploys live (initially Phase 1 detections\nhuman-reviewed-first per § B.8).\n\nRejected F2 (LLM declares phase) + F3 (no confidence gate — violates § B.10 R6\nmitigation).\n\n### (g) Counter-narrative generator — LLM bear points grounded in 3 sources\n\n`packages/infrastructure/crowd/counter_narrative_generator.py` implements\n`CounterNarrativeGeneratorPort` per UC-4 + spec § B.3 lines 425-465. LLM bear points\ngrounded in 3 sources (gatherer-wired per (d)):\n\n1. **HistoricalAnalogFinder failing analogs**: `subsequent_return_12m < -0.10`\n   threshold per spec line 442; embedding-based similarity search on historical\n   ticker-period setup-fingerprints (price_trajectory + sentiment_shape +\n   fundamental_state) per § B.4\n2. **Bullish consensus summary**: aggregated from active narratives where ticker\n   in `affected_tickers` + recent `SentimentSnapshot.dominant_sentiment()` is\n   STRONGLY_BULLISH or BULLISH\n3. **Sector structural risks**: `risk_repo.get_sector_risks(ticker)` query (cross-BC\n   contract; ticker → sector → known structural risk catalog; Phase 3 may stub-out\n   if cross-BC sector-risk repo not yet wired — flag IMPL-S53-N at entry)\n\n**MANDATORY per BR-6** when `bullish_ratio() > 0.8` on considered ticker (gates\npositive signal issuance per I-S13). Triggered via `CounterNarrativeRequested` event\non sentiment threshold crossing. Verifier S53 close test: regex match\non bear_point output for `\\d+\\s*%|approximately|roughly|around \\d+` raises\n`LlmOutputViolatesISOne`.\n\nRejected G2 (template-based — spec § C.1 rejects) + G3 (freeform no grounding —\nviolates BR-6 + I-S2).\n\n### (h) Coordination detection — 3-feature extractor + conservative threshold\n\n`packages/infrastructure/crowd/coordination_detector.py` implements\n`CoordinationDetectorPort`.
